picks.question: Will inflation reach more than 4.5% in 2026?
picks.why: Inflation above 4.5% would signal renewed price pressure, complicating Federal Reserve rate cuts and squeezing household real incomes.

picks.question: Will the unemployment rate (U-3) be above 4.2% in November?
picks.why: A rising jobless rate would be an early sign the U.S. labor market is cooling faster than policymakers expect.

picks.question: Strait of Hormuz traffic returns to normal by December 31?
picks.why: The Strait of Hormuz carries about a fifth of global oil, so prolonged disruption keeps energy prices and inflation elevated.

picks.question: Will Google have the best AI model at the end of December 2026?
picks.why: Which lab leads frontier AI shapes where investment, talent, and market power concentrate in a technology reshaping productivity.

picks.question: OpenAI IPO closing market cap above $1.2T?
picks.why: A trillion-dollar-plus OpenAI debut would test whether public markets validate the enormous capital flowing into AI.

picks.question: Will OpenAI announce another Millennium Prize solution by December 31, 2027?
picks.why: An AI-produced solution to a famous unsolved math problem would mark a striking leap in machine reasoning with broad scientific implications.
